title: Stolen Car Suspects Do Every Wrong Thing During Traffic Stop
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On July 1, 2022, an officer observed a reported stolen vehicle driving through Neillsville, WI. When he conducted a traffic stop, the driver and passenger immediately exited the vehicle. As he attempted to detain both occupants, the driver continuously reached into the vehicle while the passenger was continuously unruly and non-compliant. The officer had to call for assistance due to the situation.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
